product_one_liner.value: Gushwork provides AI marketing agents for small and midsize businesses that improve discovery across AI search, Google, and paid channels and help generate qualified inbound leads.

pricing_page.notes: The page states that pricing starts at $900 per month.

employee_band.notes: The company record reports 80 employees for May 2026; a LinkedIn profile reports a conflicting count of 202, so this band is based on the more specific employee-count record.

hq_location.notes: The company profile lists San Francisco, California, US as its primary location.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows marketing and SEO articles, not at least two engineering or technical posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage did not expose a public product documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The available open-role list includes engineering, sales, and marketing roles but no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed product, blog, terms, and privacy materials refer to AI providers generically but do not identify which model provider the product uses.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy discusses GDPR as a legal framework but does not publicly claim any of the listed items as a certification.

last_funding.notes: The company announced the $9 million seed round on February 26, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $9 million seed round was announced in February 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open-role list includes sales development and business development representative roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Gushwork announced “Bringing high-value B2B commerce to the agentic web” on July 21, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available leadership profiles and announcements did not establish a dated C-level or VP-level join or departure in the relevant period.
